title: Verdant 42 — Market: Fantasy Shop Interiors Tileset for RPG Maker MZ, Tiled & Godot, Stocked & Empty [16x16]
shortText: Fantasy shop interiors: 12 fixtures each stocked and empty, 31 wares, 444 tiles for MZ, Tiled, Godot.
description:
The shops a fantasy town needs, stocked or sold out. 444 tiles at 16x16 in one 92-colour palette: a weaponsmith, an armourer, an apothecary, a bakery, a magic stall and an adventurers' guild inside one market hall. Commercial use permitted in unlimited projects, no attribution required; you may not resell the tiles themselves as an asset pack.

What is in it

  • 12 shop fixtures, each EMPTY and STOCKED: weapon rack, polearm stand, shield board, armour stand, potion shelf, scroll cabinet, bakery rack, bread basket, display table, guild notice board, arrow barrel and produce crate. Both states share one footprint and every fixture pixel, so a shop sells out or restocks by swapping one tile, and tiles.json names the pair for your scripts.
  • 31 wares for the counters: swords and a dagger, a spear, a halberd and a glaive, three bows, four shields, helms, a breastplate and a leather jerkin, six potions, three scrolls and four kinds of bread. The stocked shelves and racks carry the same wares.
  • 282 transition tiles in 6 complete 47-mask sets: panelled walls and counters of any shape on the boards and on the tiles, a tiled floor inside the boards, and a rug on the tiles. Every inner corner, outer corner, edge, junction and single is there.
  • Built inside Verdant 07 — Interiors: the floorboards, plaster and rug are Verdant 07's own, byte for byte, so these shops sit beside its inn and cottage without a seam. This pack stands alone; you do not need Verdant 07.
  • A finished 36x24 sample map with every set and every fixture on it, as PNG, JSON and a Tiled .tmx.

Engines

  • RPG Maker MZ: every set on the A2 sheet as MZ's own autotile brush; every shape was composed back out of the sheet with MZ's own autotile table (288 of 288 identical). Tested against the table, not inside the MZ editor. Objects on the B, C and D sheets.
  • Tiled: one .tsx per sheet; Tiled's own renderer drew the sample map identical to ours (884,736 px, 0 differ).
  • Godot 4: one TileSet, loaded and verified in Godot 4.7.2 (444 tiles built).

Nothing in this pack animates. The GIF above is two shops on the sample map selling out and restocking: the wares leave the counters, every stocked fixture is swapped for its empty twin, and then the stock comes back.

The proofs

Every tile's wrap boundary is measured against its own interior, and every 4x4 repetition is rendered and reviewed. Grid, palette and autotile completeness are machine-proven: every tile is exactly 16x16, every pixel is inside the 92-colour palette, and alpha is strictly on or off.

More from the series

Verdant 07 — Interiors for the inn, cottage, workshop, chapel and study, and Verdant 09 — Town for the streets outside.

AI disclosure

Every tile is generated by our own procedural drawing engine, which is AI-written software. No image model, no scraped art and no training dataset were used, and nothing was traced.
